title: Faking Orgasm
summary: Faking an orgasm means pretending to climax, often to end sex, protect a partner's feelings or avoid pressure. It's common, but it can hide what someone actually enjoys.
key_points: Honest, kind communication about what feels good usually helps both partners more.
